# Differential gene expression analysis for maternal alcohol exposure (crude model)
```{r}
# Check the data types
sapply(coldata, class)

# Deseq
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = cts,
                              colData = coldata,
                              design = ~ heavyExpYN)
dds #63677 genes

# Variables Used
# heavyExpYN : heavy exposure binary variable (Yes = 1, No = 0)
# lgaadxp : average daily ounces prenatal absolute alcohol +1
# aaddxp : average ounces prenatal absolute alcohol per drinking occasion
# pregnancy_drinking_perc : percent of days on which mother drank alcohol prenatally
# moage_t0 : maternal age
# mograde :	maternal education (yrs completed)
# ses :	Hollingshead score
# cigpday :	number of cigarettes/day
# potxp :	days/month marijuana use
# tikxp :	days/month methamphetamine use
# ga_final : weeks gestation at delivery
# sex :	sex 
# age5yr : age at blood draw
# RINe : RIN scores (higher RIN score means higher quality)
# Cell types...

```

# Filtering: subset to protein-coding genes and remove lowly expressed counts
```{r}
txdb <- import("../../gencode.v46.annotation.gtf/gencode.v46.annotation.gtf", format="gtf")

txdb_biotype<-unique(data.frame(GENEID=mcols(txdb)$gene_id,TXTYPE=mcols(txdb)$gene_type))
# Remove version from geneid
txdb_biotype$GENEID <- sub("\\..*", "", txdb_biotype$GENEID)
txdb_dds<-txdb_biotype[txdb_biotype$GENEID%in%row.names(counts(dds)),] 

# Label mRNA species
txdb_dds<-txdb_dds%>%mutate(TXTYPE=factor(ifelse(TXTYPE=="protein_coding","protein_coding",ifelse(TXTYPE=="lncRNA","lncRNA",ifelse(TXTYPE=="processed_pseudogene","processed_pseudogene",ifelse(TXTYPE=="transcribed_unprocessed_pseudogene","transcribed_unprocessed_pseudogene",ifelse(TXTYPE=="unprocessed_pseudogene","unprocessed_pseudogene","other_RNA")))))))

# Remove lowly expressed
keep<-rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 5
summary(keep) #44474 genes
dds <- dds[keep,]
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) > 10) >= 0.5*(ncol(dds))
summary(keep) #22230 genes
dds<-dds[keep,]

# Plot detected mRNA species captured in data
txdb_dds_filter<-txdb_dds[txdb_dds$GENEID%in%row.names(counts(dds)),] 

mRNA_profile<-ggplot(txdb_dds_filter, aes(reorder(TXTYPE,TXTYPE,function(x)-length(x))))+
  geom_bar()+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.title=element_blank(),
    axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1,vjust=1))

mRNA_profile

# Observation: most genes are protein coding

# Restrict data to protein-coding 
coding <-txdb_dds$GENEID[txdb_dds$TXTYPE=="protein_coding"]
dds <-dds[row.names(counts(dds)) %in% coding, ]
nrow(dds) #13565

```

# Gene annotation
```{r}
dds_ensembl<-gsub("\\..*", "", rownames(dds))

#ensembl = useMart("ensembl",dataset="hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
#mapping <- getBM(attributes=c("hgnc_symbol","ensembl_gene_id", "chromosome_name"), filters = "ensembl_gene_id", mart=ensembl, values=dds_ensembl)

#gene_symbol_mapping<-mapping |>
#  group_by(ensembl_gene_id) |>
#  mutate(name_total=paste(hgnc_symbol,collapse=";")) |>
#  mutate(name_total=na_if(name_total,""),
#         name_total=ifelse(is.na(name_total),ensembl_gene_id,name_total)) |>
#  distinct()

mapping <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys = dds_ensembl,
    keytype = "ENSEMBL",
    columns = c("SYMBOL", "CHR")
)
colnames(mapping) <- c(
    "ensembl_gene_id",
    "hgnc_symbol",
    "chromosome_name"
)

gene_symbol_mapping <- mapping |>
  group_by(ensembl_gene_id) |>
  summarise(
    hgnc_symbol = paste(unique(na.omit(hgnc_symbol)), collapse = ";"),
    chromosome_name = paste(unique(na.omit(chromosome_name)), collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    hgnc_symbol = na_if(hgnc_symbol, ""),
    hgnc_symbol = ifelse(is.na(hgnc_symbol), ensembl_gene_id, hgnc_symbol),
    chromosome_name = na_if(chromosome_name, "")
  )

```

# Normalization using vst
```{r}
dds_norm <- vst(dds)

# Format normalized data for WGCNA
normalized_counts <- assay(dds_norm) %>%
  t() # Transpose this data

# Save normalized_counts 
write.csv(normalized_counts, file="wgcna_preschool/normalized_counts.csv")

```

# Determine parameters for WGCNA
```{r}
# Identify good choices
sft <- pickSoftThreshold(normalized_counts,
  dataIsExpr = TRUE,
  corFnc = cor,
  corOptions = list(use = 'p'),
  # do unsigned because we don't care if it's negatively or positively correlated
  networkType = "unsigned"
)

# Calculate the measure of the model fit, unsigned R^2
sft_df <- data.frame(sft$fitIndices) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(model_fit = -sign(slope) * SFT.R.sq)

# Plot the model fitting by the power soft threshold so we can decide on a soft-threshold
ggplot(sft_df, aes(x = Power, y = model_fit, label = Power)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(nudge_y = 0.1) +
  # WGCNA recommends 0.8 as an R^2 cutoff
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, col = "blue") +
  # We want to make sure we can still see the 0.80 level if values are low
  ylim(c(min(sft_df$model_fit), 1.05)) +
  xlab("Soft Threshold (power)") +
  ylab("Scale Free Topology Model Fit, unsigned R^2") +
  ggtitle("Scale independence") +
  theme_classic()

# Use a power where the signed R^2 values are around 0.8, >0.8 is okay too
# I am using a power soft threshold of 7 (R^2 ~ 0.835)
# Low R^2 values means there are too many lowly expressed genes in the data set

```

# Adjacency matrix and TOM
```{r}
softPower = 7
adjacency = adjacency(normalized_counts, type='unsigned', power = softPower)

TOM = TOMsimilarity(adjacency)
dissTOM = 1-TOM

geneTree = hclust(as.dist(dissTOM), method = "average")
# Plot the resulting clustering tree (dendrogram)
sizeGrWindow(12,9)
plot(geneTree, xlab="", sub="", main = "Gene clustering on TOM-based dissimilarity",
     labels = FALSE, hang = 0.04)

```

# Merge modules
```{r}
minModuleSize = 30; # Each module has at least 30 genes
# Module identification using dynamic tree cut:
dynamicMods = cutreeDynamic(dendro = geneTree, distM = dissTOM,
                deepSplit = 2, pamRespectsDendro = FALSE,
                minClusterSize = minModuleSize);
table(dynamicMods) # 26 modules (plus an unmapped genes module)

```

# Format colors
```{r}
dynamicColors = labels2colors(dynamicMods)
table(dynamicColors)

# Plot the dendrogram and colors underneath
sizeGrWindow(8,6)
plotDendroAndColors(geneTree, dynamicColors, "Dynamic Tree Cut",
                    dendroLabels = FALSE, hang = 0.03,
                    addGuide = TRUE, guideHang = 0.05,
                    main = "Gene dendrogram and module colors")

```

# Extract eigengenes and merge similar modules
```{r}
# Calculate eigengenes
MEList = moduleEigengenes(normalized_counts, colors = dynamicColors)
MEs = MEList$eigengenes
MEs=orderMEs(MEs)

plotEigengeneNetworks(MEs, "Eigengene adjacency heatmap", marHeatmap = c(3,4,2,2),
plotDendrograms = FALSE, xLabelsAngle = 90)

# Calculate dissimilarity of module eigengenes
MEDiss = 1-cor(MEs);
# Cluster module eigengenes
METree = hclust(as.dist(MEDiss), method = "average");
# Plot the result
sizeGrWindow(7, 6)
plot(METree, main = "Clustering of module eigengenes",
     xlab = "", sub = "")
# Plot the cut line into the dendrogram at cut height = 0.25
abline(h=0.25, col = "red")

# Look at module correlations
MEDissThres = c(0.25, 0.35,0.45,0.55)

for (i in MEDissThres) {
  merge=mergeCloseModules(normalized_counts,MEs=MEs,dynamicColors, cutHeight = i, verbose = 3) #merge function
  mergedColors = merge$colors; #merged module colors
  mergedMEs = merge$newMEs; #merged eigengenes
  j = gsub("\\.", "", as.character(i))
  pdf(paste0("wgcna_preschool/ME_correlations_",j,".pdf"))
  par(cex = 1.0)
  plotEigengeneNetworks(mergedMEs, paste0("Eigengene dendrogram and heatmap at cutheight ",i), marDendro = c(0,4,2,0),marHeatmap = c(3,4,2,2),
  plotDendrograms = TRUE, xLabelsAngle = 90)
  dev.off()

}

# Cut height of 0.25 has 14 modules, 0.35 has 11 modules, 0.45 has 10 modules, 0.55 has 8 modules
# Using a cut height of 0.25 because it has a good number of modules (14)

```

# Save merged network at cutheight 0.25
```{r}
merge=mergeCloseModules(normalized_counts,MEs=MEs,dynamicColors, cutHeight = 0.25, verbose = 3) #merge function
mergedColors = merge$colors; #merged module colors
mergedMEs = merge$newMEs; #merged eigengenes

# Rename to moduleColors
moduleColors = mergedColors
# Construct numerical labels corresponding to the colors
colorOrder = c("grey", standardColors(50));
moduleLabels = match(moduleColors, colorOrder)-1;
MEs = mergedMEs; #14 modules + grey module

# Save module colors and labels for use in subsequent parts
save(MEs, moduleLabels, moduleColors, geneTree, TOM,file = "wgcna_preschool/WGCNA_mergednatwork_025_modulecolorslabels.RData")

# Save module eigengene scores
MEs_traits<-MEs%>%
  rownames_to_column(.,var = "SID")%>%
  left_join(coldata %>% rownames_to_column(.,var = "SID"), by = "SID")
  
# Save MEs_traits as a csv file (includes ID, ME scores, and covariates and variables from coldata), used to look at correlations between ME scores and covariates
write.csv(MEs_traits, file="wgcna_preschool/ModuleEigengenes_025_scores.csv")

```

# Correlate MEs with continuous variables
```{r}
load("wgcna_preschool/WGCNA_mergednatwork_025_modulecolorslabels.RData")
normalized_counts <- read.csv("wgcna_preschool/normalized_counts.csv", row.names=1)

# Define numbers of genes and samples
nGenes = ncol(normalized_counts);
nSamples = nrow(normalized_counts);
# Recalculate MEs with color labels
MEs0 = moduleEigengenes(normalized_counts, moduleColors)$eigengenes %>% select(-MEgrey)
MEs = orderMEs(MEs0)

# Create subsetted dataset with continuous variables of interest
datTraits_numeric<-coldata%>%
  dplyr::select(lgaadxp, aaddxp, pregnancy_drinking_perc, moage_t0, mograde, cigpday, potxp, ga_final, age5yr,
                RINe, Neutrophils, T.cells.CD4.memory.resting, NK.cells.activated, T.cells.CD8, B.cells.naive,
                Monocytes, T.cells.CD4.naive, Macrophages.M2)%>%
  mutate_all(as.numeric)

# Compute correlations between ME values and continuous variables    
moduleTraitCor = cor(MEs, datTraits_numeric, use = "p");
moduleTraitPvalue = corPvalueStudent(moduleTraitCor, nSamples);

# Configure plotting parameters for correlation heatmap (only display R values for significant correlations)
#sizeGrWindow(9,7)
# Will display correlations and their p-values
textMatrix2 <-ifelse(moduleTraitPvalue<0.05,paste(signif(moduleTraitCor,2)), NA)
dim(textMatrix2) = dim(moduleTraitCor)
ySymbols<-str_remove(names(MEs),"ME")

# Display heatmap of ME correlations with continuous demographic variables
par(mar = c(8, 8, 1, 1));
print(labeledHeatmap(Matrix = moduleTraitCor,
               xLabels = names(datTraits_numeric),
               yLabels = names(MEs),
               ySymbols = str_remove(names(MEs),"ME"),
               colorLabels = FALSE,
               colors = blueWhiteRed(50),
               textMatrix = textMatrix2,
               setStdMargins = FALSE,
               cex.text = 0.8,
               zlim = c(-1,1)))

# Save heatmap as pdf
pdf("wgcna_preschool/ME_conttraits_025.pdf", width=9, height=10)
par(mar = c(8, 8, 1, 1));
labeledHeatmap(Matrix = moduleTraitCor,
               xLabels = names(datTraits_numeric),
               yLabels = names(MEs),
               ySymbols = str_remove(names(MEs),"ME"),
               colorLabels = FALSE,
               colors = blueWhiteRed(50),
               textMatrix = textMatrix2,
               setStdMargins = FALSE,
               cex.text = 0.8,
               zlim = c(-1,1))
dev.off()

# Observations: A lot of the modules are correlated with RINe and the 8 cell types, some modules also correlated with alcohol exposure variables (darkgrey, grey60), maternal education (darkgrey, grey60, magenta), and age5yr (darkgrey, lightyellow).

```

# ME mean differences by categorical variables
```{r}
# Compute t.tests for difference in mean ME values across categorical variables
eigen_cat_ttest<-MEs%>%
  rownames_to_column(.,var = "SID")%>%
  left_join(coldata %>% rownames_to_column(.,var = "SID"), by = "SID")%>%
  dplyr::select(SID, heavyExpYN, sex, starts_with("ME",ignore.case=FALSE))%>%
  mutate(sex=factor(sex),
         heavyExpYN=factor(heavyExpYN))%>%
  pivot_longer(!c(SID,starts_with("ME",ignore.case=FALSE)),names_to="Demo",values_to="Demo_value")%>%
  pivot_longer(!c(SID,Demo,Demo_value),names_to="ME",values_to="ME_value")%>%
  mutate(group=paste(Demo,ME,sep="_"))%>%
  nest(data = -group) %>% 
  mutate(
    test = map(data, ~ t.test(ME_value ~ Demo_value, data = .x)),
    tidied = map(test, tidy)
  ) %>% 
  unnest(tidied)

sig.MEs<-eigen_cat_ttest%>%
  filter(p.value<0.05)%>%
  mutate(ME=str_remove(group, ".*_"))%>%
  pull(ME)

#MEgrey60: heavyExpYN
#MEdarkred: heavyExpYN
#MEmagenta: heavyExpYN, sex
#MEdarkgrey: heavyExpYN
#MEmidnightblue: sex
#MEblack: sex

# Display boxplots of MEs differentially coexpressed across categorical variables
MEs_cat_boxplot<-MEs%>%
  rownames_to_column(.,var = "SID")%>%
  left_join(coldata %>% rownames_to_column(.,var = "SID"), by = "SID")%>%
  dplyr::select(SID, heavyExpYN, sex, starts_with("ME",ignore.case=FALSE))%>%
  mutate(sex=factor(sex),
         heavyExpYN=factor(heavyExpYN))%>%
  pivot_longer(!c(SID,starts_with("ME")),names_to="Demo",values_to="Demo_value")%>%
  pivot_longer(!c(SID,Demo,Demo_value),names_to="ME",values_to="ME_value")%>%
  mutate(group=paste(Demo,ME,sep="_"))%>%
  filter(ME%in%sig.MEs)%>%
  mutate(ME=str_remove(ME,"ME"))%>%
  ggplot(.,aes(x=Demo_value, y=ME_value))+
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill=Demo_value)) +
  #geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(significant, "*", "")))+
  # scale_y_log10()+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.title=element_blank(),
        axis.text.y=element_text(size=14),
        axis.text.x=element_text(size=14,angle=25,vjust=0.5),
        legend.position = 'none',
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12))+
  facet_grid(ME~Demo,space="free",scales='free')

MEs_cat_boxplot

# Save boxplot as pdf
pdf("wgcna_preschool/ME_cattraits_025.pdf")
MEs_cat_boxplot
dev.off()

# Observations: MEmagenta, MEmidnightblue, and MEblack has statistically significant difference in mean ME values between sex; MEgrey60, MEdarkred, MEmagenta, and MEdarkgrey has statistically significant difference in mean ME values between heavyExpYN

```

# Add hgnc symbol and chromosome name to res
```{r}
# Differential gene expression analysis continued

# Overall
res <- results(dds, contrast=c("heavyExpYN","0","1"), tidy=TRUE)
# res_merged will include hgnc symbols and chromosome numbers
res_merged <- res
# Rename ensembl_gene_id column in order to merge
colnames(res_merged)[colnames(res_merged) == "row"] <- "ensembl_gene_id"
# Added hgnc symbol and chromosome name to res_merged
res_merged <- merge(res_merged, gene_symbol_mapping, by = "ensembl_gene_id", all.x = TRUE)
res_merged <- res_merged[order(res_merged$padj),]
res_merged

# Female
res_female <- results(dds_female, contrast=c("heavyExpYN","0","1"), tidy=TRUE)
res_merged_female <- res_female
colnames(res_merged_female)[colnames(res_merged_female) == "row"] <- "ensembl_gene_id"
res_merged_female <- merge(res_merged_female, gene_symbol_mapping, by = "ensembl_gene_id", all.x = TRUE)
res_merged_female <- res_merged_female[order(res_merged_female$padj),]
res_merged_female

# Male
res_male <- results(dds_male, contrast=c("heavyExpYN","0","1"), tidy=TRUE)
res_merged_male <- res_male
colnames(res_merged_male)[colnames(res_merged_male) == "row"] <- "ensembl_gene_id"
res_merged_male <- merge(res_merged_male, gene_symbol_mapping, by = "ensembl_gene_id", all.x = TRUE)
res_merged_male <- res_merged_male[order(res_merged_male$padj),]
res_merged_male

```

# Create dataset mapping genes to modules (and add hgnc symbols)
```{r}
modNames = substring(names(MEs), 3)

geneModuleMembership = as.data.frame(cor(normalized_counts, MEs, use = "p"));
MMPvalue = as.data.frame(corPvalueStudent(as.matrix(geneModuleMembership), nSamples));

names(geneModuleMembership) = paste("MM", modNames, sep="");
names(MMPvalue) = paste("p.MM", modNames, sep="");

# Add gene annotations
annot = res_merged;
annot<-annot%>%
  distinct(ensembl_gene_id,.keep_all=TRUE)%>%
  dplyr::select(ensembl_gene_id,hgnc_symbol,chromosome_name)

geneModuleMembership<-geneModuleMembership%>%
  rownames_to_column(var="ensembl_gene_id")%>%
  left_join(annot%>%dplyr::select(ensembl_gene_id, hgnc_symbol,chromosome_name), by = "ensembl_gene_id")%>%
  mutate(modColor=moduleColors)%>%
  relocate(c(hgnc_symbol,chromosome_name,modColor), .after = ensembl_gene_id)

write.csv(geneModuleMembership,file="wgcna_preschool/WGCNA_gene_MM_025.csv")

length(unique(moduleColors)) # 14 modules + unmapped module
# 4 additional columns include ensemble_gene_id, hgnc symbol, chromosome_name, and modColor (which module the gene is from)
length((colnames(geneModuleMembership)))

# geneModuleMembership is the dataset with all the genes/hgnc symbols, the modules they belong to, and ME scores across all the modules (it is WGCNA_modules)

```

# Assign biological processes to modules based on gene ontology enrichment
```{r}
WGCNA_modules<-read.csv("wgcna_preschool/WGCNA_gene_MM_025.csv",row.names=1)

listEnrichrSites()
setEnrichrSite("Enrichr") # Human genes
websiteLive <- TRUE
dbs <- listEnrichrDbs()

gene_list<-list()
for (i in unique(WGCNA_modules$modColor)) {
  gene_list[[i]]<-WGCNA_modules$hgnc_symbol[WGCNA_modules$modColor==i]
}

KEGG_enrich <- lapply(gene_list, function(x) 
                 enrichr(x, databases = "KEGG_2021_Human")[[1]])
names(KEGG_enrich) <- paste0(names(KEGG_enrich), '_KEGG')
list2env(KEGG_enrich, .GlobalEnv)

GOmf_enrich <- lapply(gene_list, function(x) 
                 enrichr(x, databases = "GO_Molecular_Function_2021")[[1]])
names(GOmf_enrich) <- paste0(names(GOmf_enrich), '_GOmf')
list2env(GOmf_enrich, .GlobalEnv)

GOcc_enrich <- lapply(gene_list, function(x) 
                 enrichr(x, databases = "GO_Cellular_Component_2021")[[1]])
names(GOcc_enrich) <- paste0(names(GOcc_enrich), '_GOcc')
list2env(GOcc_enrich, .GlobalEnv)

# This one is usually used
GObp_enrich <- lapply(gene_list, function(x) 
                 enrichr(x, databases = "GO_Biological_Process_2021")[[1]])
names(GObp_enrich) <- paste0(names(GObp_enrich), '_GObp')
list2env(GObp_enrich, .GlobalEnv)

# Save the gene ontology's
saveRDS(KEGG_enrich,"wgcna_preschool/GO/WGCNA_enrich_KEGG_025.RDS")
saveRDS(GOmf_enrich,"wgcna_preschool/GO/WGCNA_enrich_GOmf_025.RDS")
saveRDS(GOcc_enrich,"wgcna_preschool/GO/WGCNA_enrich_GOcc_025.RDS")
saveRDS(GObp_enrich,"wgcna_preschool/GO/WGCNA_enrich_GObp_025.RDS")
```

# Create function that runs linear regression models testing associations between MEs and specified predictor associated with alcohol use (runs crude model, model adjusting for some covariates, and model adjusting for some covariates and cell types)
```{r}
all <- read.csv("wgcna_preschool/ModuleEigengenes_025_scores.csv") |>
  select(-MEgrey)
male <- all |> filter(sex == 1)
female <- all |> filter(sex == 2)

layout <- c(area(t = 0, l = 0, b = 30, r = 7),
            area(t = 2.5, l = 8, b = 30, r =11 ),
            area(t = 0, l = 12, b = 30, r = 15),
            area(t = 2.5, l = 16, b = 30, r = 19),
            area(t = 0, l = 20, b = 30, r = 23),
            area(t = 2.5, l = 24, b = 30, r = 27)
            )

glmplot_function <- function(data, predictor) {
  
  # Run linear regressions
  
  MEs_long<-data%>%
  dplyr::select(SID, starts_with("ME",ignore.case=FALSE), moage_t0, mograde, age5yr, RINe,
                Neutrophils, T.cells.CD4.memory.resting, NK.cells.activated, T.cells.CD8, B.cells.naive,
                Monocytes, T.cells.CD4.naive, Macrophages.M2, predictor)%>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with("ME",ignore.case=FALSE),names_to="Module",values_to="Score")
  
  # Detect if the predictor is binary
  binary <- is.factor(MEs_long[[predictor]]) && length(levels(MEs_long[[predictor]])) == 2
  # If else statement for formulas and filter terms
  if (binary) {
    formula_crude <- as.formula(paste("Score ~ factor(", predictor, ")"))
    formula_covs <- as.formula(paste("Score ~ factor(", predictor, ") + moage_t0 + mograde +
                                     age5yr + RINe"))
    formula_covscells <- as.formula(paste("Score ~ factor(", predictor, ") + moage_t0 + mograde + 
    age5yr + RINe + Neutrophils + T.cells.CD4.memory.resting + NK.cells.activated + 
    T.cells.CD8 + B.cells.naive + Monocytes + T.cells.CD4.naive + Macrophages.M2"))
    filter_predictor <- paste("factor(", predictor, ")1")
  } else {
    formula_crude <- as.formula(paste("Score ~ ", predictor))
    formula_covs <- as.formula(paste("Score ~ ", predictor, " + moage_t0 + mograde + 
                                     age5yr + RINe"))
    formula_covscells <- as.formula(paste("Score ~ ", predictor, " + moage_t0 + mograde + 
    age5yr + RINe + Neutrophils + T.cells.CD4.memory.resting + NK.cells.activated + 
    T.cells.CD8 + B.cells.naive + Monocytes + T.cells.CD4.naive + Macrophages.M2"))
    filter_predictor <- predictor
    }
  
  glm_crude<-MEs_long%>%
    nest(data=-c(Module))%>%
    mutate(
      test=map(data, ~lm(formula_crude, data=.x)),
      tidied=map(test, tidy, conf.int=TRUE)
      ) %>%
    unnest(tidied)%>%
    mutate(model="glm_crude")
  
  glm_crude_predictor<-glm_crude%>%
    filter(term==filter_predictor)%>%
    dplyr::select(Module, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, conf.low, conf.high, model)
  
  glm_covs<-MEs_long%>%
    nest(data=-c(Module))%>%
    mutate(
      test=map(data, ~lm(formula_covs, data=.x)),
      tidied=map(test, tidy, conf.int=TRUE)
      ) %>%
    unnest(tidied)%>%
    mutate(model="glm_covs")
  
  glm_covs_predictor<-glm_covs%>%
    filter(term==filter_predictor)%>%
    dplyr::select(Module, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, conf.low, conf.high, model)
  
  glm_covscells<-MEs_long%>%
    nest(data=-c(Module))%>%
    mutate(
      test=map(data, ~lm(formula_covscells, data=.x)),
      tidied=map(test,tidy,conf.int=TRUE)
      ) %>%
    unnest(tidied)%>%
    mutate(model="glm_covscells")
  
  glm_covscells_predictor<-glm_covscells%>%
    filter(term==filter_predictor)%>%
    dplyr::select(Module, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, conf.low, conf.high, model)
  
  glms<-bind_rows(glm_crude, glm_covs, glm_covscells)%>%
    dplyr::select(Module, term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, conf.low, conf.high, model)
  glms
  
  glms_predictor<-bind_rows(glm_crude_predictor, glm_covs_predictor, glm_covscells_predictor)
  glms_predictor
  
  # Save linear regression results for the three models
  data_name <- deparse(substitute(data))
  write.csv(glms, file=paste0("wgcna_preschool/GLM/", data_name, "/", predictor, "_fullresults.csv"))
  write.csv(glms_predictor, file=paste0("wgcna_preschool/GLM/", data_name, "/", predictor, "_results.csv"))
  
  
  # Create plots
  
  crude<-glm_crude_predictor%>%
    mutate(Module=str_remove(Module,"ME"))%>%
    mutate(across(c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high),~ formatC(round(.x,2),2,format="f")),
           estimate_lab = paste0(estimate, " (", conf.low, ", ", conf.high, ")")) %>%
    mutate(p.value=ifelse(p.value<0.05,"<0.05",as.character(sprintf("%.2f", round(p.value, 2)))))%>%
    bind_rows(data.frame(Module = "Module", 
                         estimate_lab = paste0("Crude ",intToUtf8(0x03B2)," (95% CI)"), 
                         conf.low = "",conf.high = "",p.value = "p-value"))
  crude<-crude%>%
    mutate(Module=fct_rev(fct_relevel(Module, "Module")))
  
  covs<-glm_covs_predictor%>%
    mutate(Module=str_remove(Module,"ME"))%>%
    mutate(across(c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high),~ formatC(round(.x,2),2,format="f")),
           estimate_lab = paste0(estimate, " (", conf.low, ", ", conf.high, ")")) %>%
    mutate(p.value=ifelse(p.value<0.05,"<0.05",as.character(sprintf("%.2f", round(p.value, 2)))))%>%
    bind_rows(data.frame(Module = "Module", 
                         estimate_lab = paste0("Covs ",intToUtf8(0x03B2)," (95% CI)"), 
                         conf.low = "",conf.high = "",p.value = "p-value"))
  covs<-covs%>%
    mutate(Module=fct_rev(fct_relevel(Module, "Module")))
  
  covscells<-glm_covscells_predictor%>%
    mutate(Module=str_remove(Module,"ME"))%>%
    mutate(across(c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high),~ formatC(round(.x,2),2,format="f")),
           estimate_lab = paste0(estimate, " (", conf.low, ", ", conf.high, ")")) %>%
    mutate(p.value=ifelse(p.value<0.05,"<0.05",as.character(sprintf("%.2f", round(p.value, 2)))))%>%
    bind_rows(data.frame(Module = "Module", 
                         estimate_lab = paste0("Covs+Cells ",intToUtf8(0x03B2)," (95% CI)"),
                         conf.low = "",conf.high = "",p.value = "p-value"))
  covscells<-covscells%>%
    mutate(Module=fct_rev(fct_relevel(Module, "Module")))
  
  p_1<-crude%>%
    ggplot(aes(y = Module))+
    geom_text(aes(x = 0, label = Module), hjust = 0, fontface = "bold")+
    geom_text(aes(x = 2, label = estimate_lab), hjust = 0,
              fontface = ifelse(crude$estimate_lab == paste0("Crude ",intToUtf8(0x03B2)," (95% CI)"),
                                "bold", "plain"))+
    theme_void() +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 4))
  
  p_2<-glm_crude_predictor%>%
    filter(!Module=="Module")%>%
    ggplot(aes(y=fct_rev(Module))) + 
    geom_point(aes(x=estimate), shape=15, size=3) +
    geom_linerange(aes(xmin=conf.low, xmax=conf.high)) +
    theme_classic() + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype="dashed") +
    labs(x=expression(paste(beta, " estimate")), y="")+
    theme(axis.line.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y= element_blank(),
          axis.text.y= element_blank(),
          axis.title.y= element_blank())
  
  p_3<-covs%>%
    ggplot(aes(y = Module))+
    geom_text(aes(x = 1, label = estimate_lab), hjust = 0,
              fontface = ifelse(covs$estimate_lab == paste0("Covs ",intToUtf8(0x03B2)," (95% CI)"),
                                "bold", "plain"))+theme_void() +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 4))
  
  p_4<-glm_covs_predictor%>%
    filter(!Module=="Module")%>%
    ggplot(aes(y=fct_rev(Module))) + 
    geom_point(aes(x=estimate), shape=15, size=3) +
    geom_linerange(aes(xmin=conf.low, xmax=conf.high)) +
    theme_classic() + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype="dashed") +
    labs(x=expression(paste(beta, " estimate")), y="")+
    theme(axis.line.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y= element_blank(),
          axis.text.y= element_blank(),
          axis.title.y= element_blank())
  
  p_5<-covscells%>%
    ggplot(aes(y = Module))+
    geom_text(aes(x = 1, label = estimate_lab), hjust = 0,
              fontface = ifelse(covs$estimate_lab == paste0("Covs+Cells ",intToUtf8(0x03B2)," (95% CI)"),
                                "bold", "plain"))+
    theme_void() +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 4))
  
  p_6<-glm_covscells_predictor%>%
    filter(!Module=="Module")%>%
    ggplot(aes(y=fct_rev(Module))) + 
    geom_point(aes(x=estimate), shape=15, size=3) +
    geom_linerange(aes(xmin=conf.low, xmax=conf.high)) +
    theme_classic() + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype="dashed") +
    labs(x=expression(paste(beta, " estimate")), y="")+
    theme(axis.line.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y= element_blank(),
          axis.text.y= element_blank(),
          axis.title.y= element_blank())
  
  glm_plot<-p_1 + p_2 + p_3 + p_4 + p_5 + p_6 + plot_layout(design = layout)
  
  # Save linear regression plot
  pdf(paste0("wgcna_preschool/GLM/", data_name, "/", predictor, "_plot.pdf"), width = 18, height = 4)  
  print(glm_plot)
  dev.off()
  
  return(glm_plot)
  
}
```

# Tables for the statistically significant modules functions
```{r}
# Read in gene enrichment results
GObp_enrich <- readRDS("wgcna_preschool/GO/WGCNA_enrich_GObp_025.RDS")

# Create function
module_func <- function(color) {
  GObp_enrich[[paste0(color, "_GObp")]] |>
  dplyr::select(Term, Adjusted.P.value) |>
  dplyr::filter(Adjusted.P.value < 0.05) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Term = trimws(sub("\\(.*", "", Term))) |>
  dplyr::rename(Function = Term) |>
  head(10) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = paste(color, "Module Functions (Preschool Cohort)"),
               digits = 10)
}

module_func("black") # black module
module_func("darkgrey") # darkgrey module
module_func("darkred") # darkred module
module_func("grey60") # grey60 module
module_func("magenta") # magenta module
module_func("purple") # purple module
```

# FDR correction (models adjusting for covs)
```{r}
# Load in LR results
overall_heavyExpYN <- read.csv("wgcna_preschool/GLM/all/heavyExpYN_results.csv") |>
  filter(model == "glm_covs")
male_heavyExpYN <- read.csv("wgcna_preschool/GLM/male/heavyExpYN_results.csv") |>
  filter(model == "glm_covs")
female_heavyExpYN <- read.csv("wgcna_preschool/GLM/female/heavyExpYN_results.csv") |>
  filter(model == "glm_covs")
overall_aaddxp <- read.csv("wgcna_preschool/GLM/all/aaddxp_results.csv") |>
  filter(model == "glm_covs")
male_aaddxp <- read.csv("wgcna_preschool/GLM/male/aaddxp_results.csv") |>
  filter(model == "glm_covs")
female_aaddxp <- read.csv("wgcna_preschool/GLM/female/aaddxp_results.csv") |>
  filter(model == "glm_covs")
overall_pregnancy <- read.csv("wgcna_preschool/GLM/all/pregnancy_drinking_perc_results.csv") |>
  filter(model == "glm_covs")
male_pregnancy <- read.csv("wgcna_preschool/GLM/male/pregnancy_drinking_perc_results.csv") |>
  filter(model == "glm_covs")
female_pregnancy <- read.csv("wgcna_preschool/GLM/female/pregnancy_drinking_perc_results.csv") |>
  filter(model == "glm_covs")

# Pull numeric vectors of the p-values
overall_heavyExpYN.p <- overall_heavyExpYN |> pull(p.value) |> as.numeric()
male_heavyExpYN.p <- male_heavyExpYN |> pull(p.value) |> as.numeric()
female_heavyExpYN.p <- female_heavyExpYN |> pull(p.value) |> as.numeric()
overall_aaddxp.p <- overall_aaddxp |> pull(p.value) |> as.numeric()
male_aaddxp.p <- male_aaddxp |> pull(p.value) |> as.numeric()
female_aaddxp.p <- female_aaddxp |> pull(p.value) |> as.numeric()
overall_pregnancy.p <- overall_pregnancy |> pull(p.value) |> as.numeric()
male_pregnancy.p <- male_pregnancy |> pull(p.value) |> as.numeric()
female_pregnancy.p <- female_pregnancy |> pull(p.value) |> as.numeric()

# Add FDR correction column
overall_heavyExpYN$p.adj <- p.adjust(overall_heavyExpYN.p, method = "fdr", n = length(overall_heavyExpYN.p))
male_heavyExpYN$p.adj <- p.adjust(male_heavyExpYN.p, method = "fdr", n = length(male_heavyExpYN.p))
female_heavyExpYN$p.adj <- p.adjust(female_heavyExpYN.p, method = "fdr", n = length(female_heavyExpYN.p))
overall_aaddxp$p.adj <- p.adjust(overall_aaddxp.p, method = "fdr", n = length(overall_aaddxp.p))
male_aaddxp$p.adj <- p.adjust(male_aaddxp.p, method = "fdr", n = length(male_aaddxp.p))
female_aaddxp$p.adj <- p.adjust(female_aaddxp.p, method = "fdr", n = length(female_aaddxp.p))
overall_pregnancy$p.adj <- p.adjust(overall_pregnancy.p, method = "fdr", n = length(overall_pregnancy.p))
male_pregnancy$p.adj <- p.adjust(male_pregnancy.p, method = "fdr", n = length(male_pregnancy.p))
female_pregnancy$p.adj <- p.adjust(female_pregnancy.p, method = "fdr", n = length(female_pregnancy.p))

# Check if there are any significant p.adj values
overall_heavyExpYN.sig <- overall_heavyExpYN |> filter(p.adj<0.05)
overall_heavyExpYN.sig
male_heavyExpYN.sig <- male_heavyExpYN |> filter(p.adj<0.05)
male_heavyExpYN.sig
female_heavyExpYN.sig <- female_heavyExpYN |> filter(p.adj<0.05)
female_heavyExpYN.sig
overall_aaddxp.sig <- overall_aaddxp |> filter(p.adj<0.05)
overall_aaddxp.sig
male_aaddxp.sig <- male_aaddxp |> filter(p.adj<0.05)
male_aaddxp.sig
female_aaddxp.sig <- female_aaddxp |> filter(p.adj<0.05)
female_aaddxp.sig
overall_pregnancy.sig <- overall_pregnancy |> filter(p.adj<0.05)
overall_pregnancy.sig
male_pregnancy.sig <- male_pregnancy |> filter(p.adj<0.05)
male_pregnancy.sig
female_pregnancy.sig <- female_pregnancy |> filter(p.adj<0.05)
female_pregnancy.sig

# Observation: One FDR adjusted p-values is statistically significant. For the male_aaddxp LR, MEgrey60 is statistically signficant for covariates models.
```

# FDR correction (models adjusting for covs+cells)
```{r}
# Load in LR results
overall_heavyExpYN <- read.csv("wgcna_preschool/GLM/all/heavyExpYN_results.csv") |>

female_heavyExpYN <- read.csv("wgcna_preschool/GLM/female/heavyExpYN_results.csv") |>
  filter(model == "glm_covscells")
overall_aaddxp <- read.csv("wgcna_preschool/GLM/all/aaddxp_results.csv") |>

male_aaddxp <- read.csv("wgcna_preschool/GLM/male/aaddxp_results.csv") |>

female_aaddxp <- read.csv("wgcna_preschool/GLM/female/aaddxp_results.csv") |>
  filter(model == "glm_covscells")
overall_pregnancy <- read.csv("wgcna_preschool/GLM/all/pregnancy_drinking_perc_results.csv") |>
  filter(model == "glm_covscells")
male_pregnancy <- read.csv("wgcna_preschool/GLM/male/pregnancy_drinking_perc_results.csv") |>
  filter(model == "glm_covscells")
female_pregnancy <- read.csv("wgcna_preschool/GLM/female/pregnancy_drinking_perc_results.csv") |>
  filter(model == "glm_covscells")

# Pull numeric vectors of the p-values
overall_heavyExpYN.p <- overall_heavyExpYN |> pull(p.value) |> as.numeric()
male_heavyExpYN.p <- male_heavyExpYN |> pull(p.value) |> as.numeric()
female_heavyExpYN.p <- female_heavyExpYN |> pull(p.value) |> as.numeric()
overall_aaddxp.p <- overall_aaddxp |> pull(p.value) |> as.numeric()
male_aaddxp.p <- male_aaddxp |> pull(p.value) |> as.numeric()
female_aaddxp.p <- female_aaddxp |> pull(p.value) |> as.numeric()
overall_pregnancy.p <- overall_pregnancy |> pull(p.value) |> as.numeric()
male_pregnancy.p <- male_pregnancy |> pull(p.value) |> as.numeric()
female_pregnancy.p <- female_pregnancy |> pull(p.value) |> as.numeric()

# Add FDR correction column
overall_heavyExpYN$p.adj <- p.adjust(overall_heavyExpYN.p, method = "fdr", n = length(overall_heavyExpYN.p))
male_heavyExpYN$p.adj <- p.adjust(male_heavyExpYN.p, method = "fdr", n = length(male_heavyExpYN.p))
female_heavyExpYN$p.adj <- p.adjust(female_heavyExpYN.p, method = "fdr", n = length(female_heavyExpYN.p))
overall_aaddxp$p.adj <- p.adjust(overall_aaddxp.p, method = "fdr", n = length(overall_aaddxp.p))
male_aaddxp$p.adj <- p.adjust(male_aaddxp.p, method = "fdr", n = length(male_aaddxp.p))
female_aaddxp$p.adj <- p.adjust(female_aaddxp.p, method = "fdr", n = length(female_aaddxp.p))
overall_pregnancy$p.adj <- p.adjust(overall_pregnancy.p, method = "fdr", n = length(overall_pregnancy.p))
male_pregnancy$p.adj <- p.adjust(male_pregnancy.p, method = "fdr", n = length(male_pregnancy.p))
female_pregnancy$p.adj <- p.adjust(female_pregnancy.p, method = "fdr", n = length(female_pregnancy.p))

# Check if there are any significant p.adj values
overall_heavyExpYN.sig <- overall_heavyExpYN |> filter(p.adj<0.05)
overall_heavyExpYN.sig
male_heavyExpYN.sig <- male_heavyExpYN |> filter(p.adj<0.05)
male_heavyExpYN.sig
female_heavyExpYN.sig <- female_heavyExpYN |> filter(p.adj<0.05)
female_heavyExpYN.sig
overall_aaddxp.sig <- overall_aaddxp |> filter(p.adj<0.05)
overall_aaddxp.sig
male_aaddxp.sig <- male_aaddxp |> filter(p.adj<0.05)
male_aaddxp.sig
female_aaddxp.sig <- female_aaddxp |> filter(p.adj<0.05)
female_aaddxp.sig
overall_pregnancy.sig <- overall_pregnancy |> filter(p.adj<0.05)
overall_pregnancy.sig
male_pregnancy.sig <- male_pregnancy |> filter(p.adj<0.05)
male_pregnancy.sig
female_pregnancy.sig <- female_pregnancy |> filter(p.adj<0.05)
female_pregnancy.sig

# Observation: One FDR adjusted p-values is statistically significant. For the male_aaddxp LR, MEgrey60 is statistically signficant for covariates+cells models. 
```

# Clean LR plots function
```{r}
all <- read.csv("wgcna_preschool/ModuleEigengenes_025_scores.csv") |>
  select(-MEgrey)
male <- all |> filter(sex == 1)
female <- all |> filter(sex == 2)

layout <- c(area(t = 0, l = 0, b = 30, r = 2),
            area(t = 0, l = 3, b = 30, r = 8),
            area(t = 0, l = 9, b = 30, r = 13),
            area(t = 0, l = 14, b = 30, r = 18)
            )

glmplot_function_clean <- function(data, predictor) {
  
  # Run linear regressions
  
  MEs_long<-data%>%
  dplyr::select(SID, starts_with("ME",ignore.case=FALSE), moage_t0, mograde, age5yr, RINe,
                Neutrophils, T.cells.CD4.memory.resting, NK.cells.activated, T.cells.CD8, B.cells.naive,
                Monocytes, T.cells.CD4.naive, Macrophages.M2, predictor)%>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with("ME",ignore.case=FALSE),names_to="Module",values_to="Score")
  
  # Detect if the predictor is binary
  binary <- is.factor(MEs_long[[predictor]]) && length(levels(MEs_long[[predictor]])) == 2
  # If else statement for formulas and filter terms
  if (binary) {
    formula_covs <- as.formula(paste("Score ~ factor(", predictor, ") + moage_t0 + mograde +
                                     age5yr + RINe"))
    formula_covscells <- as.formula(paste("Score ~ factor(", predictor, ") + moage_t0 + mograde + 
    age5yr + RINe + Neutrophils + T.cells.CD4.memory.resting + NK.cells.activated + 
    T.cells.CD8 + B.cells.naive + Monocytes + T.cells.CD4.naive + Macrophages.M2"))
    filter_predictor <- paste("factor(", predictor, ")1")
  } else {
    formula_covs <- as.formula(paste("Score ~ ", predictor, " + moage_t0 + mograde + 
                                     age5yr + RINe"))
    formula_covscells <- as.formula(paste("Score ~ ", predictor, " + moage_t0 + mograde + 
    age5yr + RINe + Neutrophils + T.cells.CD4.memory.resting + NK.cells.activated + 
    T.cells.CD8 + B.cells.naive + Monocytes + T.cells.CD4.naive + Macrophages.M2"))
    filter_predictor <- predictor
    }
  
  glm_covs<-MEs_long%>%
    nest(data=-c(Module))%>%
    mutate(
      test=map(data, ~lm(formula_covs, data=.x)),
      tidied=map(test, tidy, conf.int=TRUE)
      ) %>%
    unnest(tidied)%>%
    mutate(model="glm_covs")
  
  glm_covs_predictor<-glm_covs%>%
    filter(term==filter_predictor)%>%
    dplyr::select(Module, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, conf.low, conf.high, model)
  
  glm_covscells<-MEs_long%>%
    nest(data=-c(Module))%>%
    mutate(
      test=map(data, ~lm(formula_covscells, data=.x)),
      tidied=map(test,tidy,conf.int=TRUE)
      ) %>%
    unnest(tidied)%>%
    mutate(model="glm_covscells")
  
  glm_covscells_predictor<-glm_covscells%>%
    filter(term==filter_predictor)%>%
    dplyr::select(Module, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, conf.low, conf.high, model)
  
  data_name <- deparse(substitute(data))
  
  # Create plots
  
  covs<-glm_covs_predictor%>%
    mutate(Module=str_remove(Module,"ME"))%>%
    mutate(across(c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high),~ formatC(round(.x,2),2,format="f")),
           estimate_lab = paste0(estimate, " (", conf.low, ", ", conf.high, ")")) %>%
    mutate(p.value=ifelse(p.value<0.05,"<0.05",as.character(sprintf("%.2f", round(p.value, 2)))))%>%
    mutate(Function=c("acyl-CoA metabolic process",
                      "platelet degranulation",
                      "ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process",
                      "cellular response to type I interferon",
                      "neutrophil activation involved in immune response",
                      "regulation of angiogenesis",
                      "neutrophil activation involved in immune response",
                      "mRNA processing",
                      "B cell activation",
                      "SRP-dependent cotranslational protein targeting to membrane",
                      "regulation of apoptotic process",
                      "organelle organization",
                      "mitotic spindle organization",
                      "regulation of immune response"))
  
  covscells<-glm_covscells_predictor%>%
    mutate(Module=str_remove(Module,"ME"))%>%
    mutate(across(c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high),~ formatC(round(.x,2),2,format="f")),
           estimate_lab = paste0(estimate, " (", conf.low, ", ", conf.high, ")")) %>%
    mutate(p.value=ifelse(p.value<0.05,"<0.05",as.character(sprintf("%.2f", round(p.value, 2)))))
  
  p_1<-covs%>%
    ggplot(aes(y = Module)) +
    geom_text(aes(x = 0, label = Module), hjust = 0, fontface = "bold")+
    labs(title = "Module") +
    theme_void() +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 4))
  
  p_2<-covs%>%
    ggplot(aes(y = Module))+
    geom_text(aes(x = 0, label = Function), hjust = 0) +
    labs(title = "Function") +
    theme_void() +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 4))
  
  p_3<-glm_covs_predictor%>%
    filter(!Module=="Module")%>%
    ggplot(aes(y=Module)) +
    geom_point(aes(x=estimate), shape=15, size=3) +
    geom_linerange(aes(xmin=conf.low, xmax=conf.high)) +
    theme_classic() + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype="dashed") +
    labs(title = paste0("Covariates ", intToUtf8(0x03B2), " (95% CI)"),
         x=expression(paste(beta, " estimate")), 
         y="") +
    theme(axis.line.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y= element_blank(),
          axis.text.y= element_blank(),
          axis.title.y= element_blank())
  
  p_4<-glm_covscells_predictor%>%
    filter(!Module=="Module")%>%
    ggplot(aes(y=Module)) + 
    geom_point(aes(x=estimate), shape=15, size=3) +
    geom_linerange(aes(xmin=conf.low, xmax=conf.high)) +
    theme_classic() + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype="dashed") +
    labs(title = paste0("Covariates+Cells ",intToUtf8(0x03B2)," (95% CI)"),
         x=expression(paste(beta, " estimate")), 
         y="")+
    theme(axis.line.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y= element_blank(),
          axis.text.y= element_blank(),
          axis.title.y= element_blank())
  
  glm_plot<-p_1 + p_2 + p_3 + p_4 + plot_layout(design = layout)
  
  # Save linear regression plot
  pdf(paste0("wgcna_preschool/GLM_clean_plots/", data_name, "/", predictor, "_plot.pdf"), width = 11.5, height = 4)  
  print(glm_plot)
  dev.off()
  
  return(glm_plot)
  
}
```

# Heatmap function for the effect size (covariates and covariates+cells)
```{r}
all <- read.csv("wgcna_preschool/ModuleEigengenes_025_scores.csv") |>
  select(-MEgrey)
male <- all |> filter(sex == 1)
female <- all |> filter(sex == 2)

heatmap_function <- function(data) {
  
  MEs_long<-data%>%
    dplyr::select(SID, starts_with("ME",ignore.case=FALSE), moage_t0, mograde, age5yr, RINe,
                  Neutrophils, T.cells.CD4.memory.resting, NK.cells.activated, T.cells.CD8, B.cells.naive,
                  Monocytes, T.cells.CD4.naive, Macrophages.M2, heavyExpYN, aaddxp, pregnancy_drinking_perc)%>%
    pivot_longer(starts_with("ME",ignore.case=FALSE),names_to="Module",values_to="Score")
  
  # Covariates heatmap
  
  heavyExpYN_covs<-MEs_long%>%
    nest(data=-c(Module))%>%
    mutate(
      test=map(data, ~lm(Score ~ factor(heavyExpYN) + moage_t0 + mograde + age5yr + RINe, data=.x)),
      tidied=map(test, tidy, conf.int=TRUE)
      ) %>%
    unnest(tidied)%>%
    mutate(predictor="heavyExpYN")%>%
    filter(term=="factor(heavyExpYN)1")%>%
    dplyr::select(Module, estimate, p.value, predictor)
  
  aaddxp_covs<-MEs_long%>%
    nest(data=-c(Module))%>%
    mutate(
      test=map(data, ~lm(Score ~ aaddxp + moage_t0 + mograde + age5yr + RINe, data=.x)),
      tidied=map(test, tidy, conf.int=TRUE)
      ) %>%
    unnest(tidied)%>%
    mutate(predictor="aaddxp")%>%
    filter(term=="aaddxp")%>%
    dplyr::select(Module, estimate, p.value, predictor)
  
  pregnancy_drinking_perc_covs<-MEs_long%>%
    nest(data=-c(Module))%>%
    mutate(
      test=map(data, ~lm(Score ~ pregnancy_drinking_perc + moage_t0 + mograde + age5yr + RINe, data=.x)),
      tidied=map(test, tidy, conf.int=TRUE)
      ) %>%
    unnest(tidied)%>%
    mutate(predictor="pregnancy_drinking_perc")%>%
    filter(term=="pregnancy_drinking_perc")%>%
    dplyr::select(Module, estimate, p.value, predictor)
  
  all_covs<-bind_rows(heavyExpYN_covs, aaddxp_covs, pregnancy_drinking_perc_covs)%>%
    dplyr::select(Module, estimate, p.value, predictor)
  
  all_covs<-all_covs%>%
    mutate(
      star = case_when(
        p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
        ),
      Module = str_remove(Module, "^ME"),
      Module = recode(Module,
                      tan = "tan (organelle organization)",
                      salmon = "salmon (SRP-dependent cotranslational protein targeting to membrane)",
                      purple ="purple (cellular response to type I interferon)",
                      midnightblue = "midnightblue (neutrophil activation involved in immune response)",
                      magenta = "magenta (ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process)",
                      lightyellow = "lightyellow (B cell activation)",
                      lightgreen = "lightgreen (neutrophil activation involved in immune response)",
                      lightcyan = "lightcyan (regulation of immune response)",
                      grey60 = "grey60 (acyl-CoA metabolic process)",
                      darkred = "darkred (platelet degranulation)",
                      darkorange = "darkorange (regulation of angiogenesis)",
                      darkgrey = "darkgrey (mitotic spindle organization)",
                      cyan = "cyan (mRNA processing)",
                      black = "black (regulation of apoptotic process)"
                      )
      )
  
  covs_heatmap<-ggplot(all_covs, aes(x = predictor, y = Module, fill = estimate)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = star), color="black", size = 5) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#EDF8B1",
      mid = "#7FCDBB",
      high = "#2C7FB8",
      midpoint = 0
      ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.title=element_blank(),
          axis.text=element_text(size=11)) +
    labs(fill=expression(paste(beta, " estimate"))) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = "* p < 0.05\n** p < 0.01\n*** p < 0.001",
             hjust = 0, vjust = -0.5) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off")
  
  # Save the heatmap
  data_name <- deparse(substitute(data))
  pdf(paste0("wgcna_preschool/GLM_clean_plots/", data_name, "/covs_heatmap.pdf"), width = 13, height = 4)
  print(covs_heatmap)
  dev.off()
  
  
  # Covariates+Cells heatmap
  
  heavyExpYN_covscells<-MEs_long%>%
    nest(data=-c(Module))%>%
    mutate(
      test=map(data, ~lm(Score ~ factor(heavyExpYN) + moage_t0 + mograde + age5yr + RINe + 
                           Neutrophils + T.cells.CD4.memory.resting + NK.cells.activated + 
                           T.cells.CD8 + B.cells.naive + Monocytes + T.cells.CD4.naive + Macrophages.M2,
                         data=.x)),
      tidied=map(test, tidy, conf.int=TRUE)
      ) %>%
    unnest(tidied)%>%
    mutate(predictor="heavyExpYN")%>%
    filter(term=="factor(heavyExpYN)1")%>%
    dplyr::select(Module, estimate, p.value, predictor)
  
  aaddxp_covscells<-MEs_long%>%
    nest(data=-c(Module))%>%
    mutate(
      test=map(data, ~lm(Score ~ aaddxp + moage_t0 + mograde + age5yr + RINe +
                           Neutrophils + T.cells.CD4.memory.resting + NK.cells.activated + 
                           T.cells.CD8 + B.cells.naive + Monocytes + T.cells.CD4.naive + Macrophages.M2,
                         data=.x)),
      tidied=map(test, tidy, conf.int=TRUE)
      ) %>%
    unnest(tidied)%>%
    mutate(predictor="aaddxp")%>%
    filter(term=="aaddxp")%>%
    dplyr::select(Module, estimate, p.value, predictor)
  
  pregnancy_drinking_perc_covscells<-MEs_long%>%
    nest(data=-c(Module))%>%
    mutate(
      test=map(data, ~lm(Score ~ pregnancy_drinking_perc + moage_t0 + mograde + age5yr + RINe +
                           Neutrophils + T.cells.CD4.memory.resting + NK.cells.activated + 
                           T.cells.CD8 + B.cells.naive + Monocytes + T.cells.CD4.naive + Macrophages.M2,
                         data=.x)),
      tidied=map(test, tidy, conf.int=TRUE)
      ) %>%
    unnest(tidied)%>%
    mutate(predictor="pregnancy_drinking_perc")%>%
    filter(term=="pregnancy_drinking_perc")%>%
    dplyr::select(Module, estimate, p.value, predictor)
  
  all_covscells<-bind_rows(heavyExpYN_covscells, aaddxp_covscells, pregnancy_drinking_perc_covscells)%>%
    dplyr::select(Module, estimate, p.value, predictor)
  
  all_covscells<-all_covscells%>%
    mutate(
      star = case_when(
        p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
        ),
      Module = str_remove(Module, "^ME"),
      Module = recode(Module,
                      tan = "tan (organelle organization)",
                      salmon = "salmon (SRP-dependent cotranslational protein targeting to membrane)",
                      purple ="purple (cellular response to type I interferon)",
                      midnightblue = "midnightblue (neutrophil activation involved in immune response)",
                      magenta = "magenta (ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process)",
                      lightyellow = "lightyellow (B cell activation)",
                      lightgreen = "lightgreen (neutrophil activation involved in immune response)",
                      lightcyan = "lightcyan (regulation of immune response)",
                      grey60 = "grey60 (acyl-CoA metabolic process)",
                      darkred = "darkred (platelet degranulation)",
                      darkorange = "darkorange (regulation of angiogenesis)",
                      darkgrey = "darkgrey (mitotic spindle organization)",
                      cyan = "cyan (mRNA processing)",
                      black = "black (regulation of apoptotic process)"
                      )
      )
  
  covscells_heatmap<-ggplot(all_covscells, aes(x = predictor, y = Module, fill = estimate)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = star), color="black", size = 5) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#EDF8B1",
      mid = "#7FCDBB",
      high = "#2C7FB8",
      midpoint = 0
      ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.title=element_blank(),
          axis.text=element_text(size=11)) +
    labs(fill=expression(paste(beta, " estimate"))) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = "* p < 0.05\n** p < 0.01\n*** p < 0.001",
             hjust = 0, vjust = -0.5) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off")
  
  # Save the heatmap
  pdf(paste0("wgcna_preschool/GLM_clean_plots/", data_name, "/covscells_heatmap.pdf"), width = 13, height = 4)  
  print(covscells_heatmap)
  dev.off()
}
```

```{r}
all <- read.csv("wgcna_preschool/ModuleEigengenes_025_scores.csv") |>
  select(-MEgrey)

MEs_long<-all%>%
  dplyr::select(SID, starts_with("ME",ignore.case=FALSE), moage_t0, mograde, age5yr, RINe, sex,

pregnancy_drinking_perc_covsinter<-MEs_long%>%

gt(all_covsinter) %>%

# Covariates+Cells

heavyExpYN_covscellsinter<-MEs_long%>%

  mutate(
    test=map(data, ~lm(Score ~ factor(heavyExpYN) + moage_t0 + mograde + age5yr + RINe + 
                         Neutrophils + T.cells.CD4.memory.resting + NK.cells.activated + 
                         T.cells.CD8 + B.cells.naive + Monocytes + T.cells.CD4.naive + Macrophages.M2 +
                         factor(heavyExpYN)*sex,data=.x)),
    tidied=map(test, tidy, conf.int=TRUE)
    ) %>%
  unnest(tidied)%>%
  mutate(predictor="heavyExpYN")%>%
  filter(term=="factor(heavyExpYN)1:sex")%>%
  dplyr::select(Module, p.value, predictor)

aaddxp_covscellsinter<-MEs_long%>%
  nest(data=-c(Module))%>%
  mutate(
    test=map(data, ~lm(Score ~ aaddxp + moage_t0 + mograde + age5yr + RINe +
                         Neutrophils + T.cells.CD4.memory.resting + NK.cells.activated + 
                         T.cells.CD8 + B.cells.naive + Monocytes + T.cells.CD4.naive + Macrophages.M2 + 
                         aaddxp*sex, data=.x)),
    tidied=map(test, tidy, conf.int=TRUE)
    ) %>%
  unnest(tidied)%>%
  mutate(predictor="aaddxp")%>%
  filter(term=="aaddxp:sex")%>%
  dplyr::select(Module, p.value, predictor)
  
pregnancy_drinking_perc_covscellsinter<-MEs_long%>%
  nest(data=-c(Module))%>%
  mutate(
    test=map(data, ~lm(Score ~ pregnancy_drinking_perc + moage_t0 + mograde + age5yr + RINe +
                         Neutrophils + T.cells.CD4.memory.resting + NK.cells.activated + 
                         T.cells.CD8 + B.cells.naive + Monocytes + T.cells.CD4.naive + Macrophages.M2 +
                         pregnancy_drinking_perc*sex, data=.x)),
    tidied=map(test, tidy, conf.int=TRUE)
    ) %>%
  unnest(tidied)%>%
  mutate(predictor="pregnancy_drinking_perc")%>%
  filter(term=="pregnancy_drinking_perc:sex")%>%
  dplyr::select(Module, p.value, predictor)
  
all_covscellsinter<-bind_rows(heavyExpYN_covscellsinter, aaddxp_covscellsinter,
                              pregnancy_drinking_perc_covscellsinter)%>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = predictor,
    values_from = p.value
    )

gt(all_covscellsinter) %>%
  data_color(
    columns = everything(),
    fn = function(x) {
      ifelse(x < 0.05, "red", "white")
      }
    )
```

# Clean LR plots with sex function
```{r}
layout <- c(
  area(t = 0, l = 0,  b = 30, r = 7),
  area(t = 0, l = 8,  b = 30, r = 13),
  area(t = 0, l = 14, b = 30, r = 19)
)

glmplot_function_sex <- function(predictor, sex_modules_covs, sex_modules_covscells) {
  
  data <- read.csv("wgcna_preschool/ModuleEigengenes_025_scores.csv") %>%
    select(-MEgrey)
  
  MEs_long <- data %>%
    dplyr::select(SID, starts_with("ME", ignore.case = FALSE), moage_t0, mograde, age5yr, RINe,
                  Neutrophils, T.cells.CD4.memory.resting, NK.cells.activated, T.cells.CD8,
                  B.cells.naive, Monocytes, T.cells.CD4.naive, Macrophages.M2, sex, 
                  all_of(predictor)) %>%
    pivot_longer(starts_with("ME", ignore.case = FALSE), names_to = "Module", values_to = "Score")
  
  run_models <- function(dat, sex_label) {
    
    binary <- is.factor(dat[[predictor]]) &&
      length(levels(dat[[predictor]])) == 2
    
    if (binary) {
      formula_covs <- as.formula(paste("Score ~ factor(", predictor, 
                                       ") + moage_t0 + mograde + age5yr + RINe"))
      formula_covscells <- as.formula(
        paste("Score ~ factor(", predictor, ") + moage_t0 + mograde + age5yr + RINe",
              "+ Neutrophils", "+ T.cells.CD4.memory.resting", "+ NK.cells.activated", 
              "+ T.cells.CD8", "+ B.cells.naive", "+ Monocytes", "+ T.cells.CD4.naive",
              "+ Macrophages.M2"))
      filter_predictor <- paste0("factor(", predictor, ")1")
    } else {
      formula_covs <- as.formula(paste("Score ~", predictor, "+ moage_t0 + mograde + age5yr + RINe"))
      formula_covscells <- as.formula(
        paste("Score ~", predictor, "+ moage_t0 + mograde + age5yr + RINe", "+ Neutrophils",
              "+ T.cells.CD4.memory.resting", "+ NK.cells.activated", "+ T.cells.CD8",
              "+ B.cells.naive", "+ Monocytes", "+ T.cells.CD4.naive", "+ Macrophages.M2"))
      filter_predictor <- predictor
    }
    
    glm_covs <- dat %>%
      nest(data = -Module) %>%
      mutate(test = map(data, ~ lm(formula_covs, data = .x)),
             tidied = map(test, ~ tidy(.x, conf.int = TRUE))) %>%
      unnest(tidied) %>%
      mutate(model = "glm_covs", sex = sex_label)
    
    glm_covs_predictor <- glm_covs %>%
      filter(term == filter_predictor) %>%
      dplyr::select(Module, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, conf.low,conf.high, model, sex)
    
    glm_covscells <- dat %>%
      nest(data = -Module) %>%
      mutate(test = map(data, ~ lm(formula_covscells, data = .x)),
             tidied = map(test, ~ tidy(.x, conf.int = TRUE))) %>%
      unnest(tidied) %>%
      mutate(model = "glm_covscells", sex = sex_label)
    
    
    glm_covscells_predictor <- glm_covscells %>%
      filter(term == filter_predictor) %>%
      dplyr::select(Module, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, conf.low, conf.high, model, sex)
    
    list(covs = glm_covs_predictor, covscells = glm_covscells_predictor)
    
  }
  
  all_results <- run_models(MEs_long, "All")
  
  female_results <- run_models(MEs_long %>% 
                                 filter(sex == 2), "Female")
  
  male_results <- run_models(MEs_long %>%
                               filter(sex == 1), "Male")
  
  covs_all <- bind_rows(all_results$covs, female_results$covs, male_results$covs)
  
  covscells_all <- bind_rows(all_results$covscells, female_results$covscells, male_results$covscells)
  
  covs_plot <- covs_all %>%
    mutate(Module = str_remove(Module, "^ME")) %>%
    filter(sex == "All" | (sex %in% c("Female", "Male") & Module %in% sex_modules_covs)) %>%
    mutate(Module = recode(Module,
                           tan = "tan (organelle organization)",
                           salmon = "salmon (SRP-dependent cotranslational protein targeting to membrane)",
                           purple ="purple (cellular response to type I interferon)",
                           midnightblue = "midnightblue (neutrophil activation involved in immune response)",
                           magenta = "magenta (ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process)",
                           lightyellow = "lightyellow (B cell activation)",
                           lightgreen = "lightgreen (neutrophil activation involved in immune response)",
                           lightcyan = "lightcyan (regulation of immune response)",
                           grey60 = "grey60 (acyl-CoA metabolic process)",
                           darkred = "darkred (platelet degranulation)",
                           darkorange = "darkorange (regulation of angiogenesis)",
                           darkgrey = "darkgrey (mitotic spindle organization)",
                           cyan = "cyan (mRNA processing)",
                           black = "black (regulation of apoptotic process)"
                           ))
  
  covscells_plot <- covscells_all %>%
    mutate(Module = str_remove(Module, "^ME")) %>%
    filter(sex == "All" | (sex %in% c("Female", "Male") & Module %in% sex_modules_covscells)) %>%
    mutate(Module = recode(Module,
                           tan = "tan (organelle organization)",
                           salmon = "salmon (SRP-dependent cotranslational protein targeting to membrane)",
                           purple ="purple (cellular response to type I interferon)",
                           midnightblue = "midnightblue (neutrophil activation involved in immune response)",
                           magenta = "magenta (ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process)",
                           lightyellow = "lightyellow (B cell activation)",
                           lightgreen = "lightgreen (neutrophil activation involved in immune response)",
                           lightcyan = "lightcyan (regulation of immune response)",
                           grey60 = "grey60 (acyl-CoA metabolic process)",
                           darkred = "darkred (platelet degranulation)",
                           darkorange = "darkorange (regulation of angiogenesis)",
                           darkgrey = "darkgrey (mitotic spindle organization)",
                           cyan = "cyan (mRNA processing)",
                           black = "black (regulation of apoptotic process)"
                           ))
  
  p_1 <- covs_plot %>%
    filter(sex == "All") %>%
    ggplot(aes(y = Module)) +
    geom_text(aes(x = 0, label = Module), hjust = 0, fontface = "plain", size = 3.5) +
    labs(title = "Module") +
    theme_void() +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 4))
  
  p_2 <- covs_plot %>%
    filter(Module != "Module") %>%
    ggplot(aes(y = Module, color = sex, shape = sex)) +
    geom_linerange(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(aes(x = estimate), size = 3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("All" = scales::alpha("black", 0.75),
                                  "Female" = scales::alpha("pink", 0.75),
                                  "Male" = scales::alpha("lightblue", 0.75))) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("All" = 15, "Female" = 15, "Male" = 15)) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = paste0("Covariates ", intToUtf8(0x03B2), " (95% CI)"),
         x = expression(paste(beta, " estimate")), y = "", color = "", shape = "") +
    
    theme(axis.line.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank())
  
  p_3 <- covscells_plot %>%
    filter(Module != "Module") %>%
    ggplot(aes(y = Module, color = sex, shape = sex)) +
    geom_linerange(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(aes(x = estimate), size = 3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("All" = scales::alpha("black", 0.75),
                                  "Female" = scales::alpha("pink", 0.75),
                                  "Male" = scales::alpha("lightblue", 0.75))) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("All" = 15, "Female" = 15, "Male" = 15)) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = paste0("Covariates+Cells ", intToUtf8(0x03B2), " (95% CI)"),
         x = expression(paste(beta, " estimate")), y = "", color = "", shape = "") +
    theme(axis.line.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank())
  
  glm_plot <- p_1 + p_2 + p_3 + plot_layout(design = layout, guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  # Save linear regression plot
  pdf(paste0("wgcna_preschool/GLM_clean_plots_sex/", predictor, "_plot.pdf"), width = 13, height = 4)
  print(glm_plot)
  dev.off()
  
  return(glm_plot)
  
}
```
